current.note: Client missions and product work run in parallel.

projects.name: Mentormatic
highlights: Full-stack work on a B2B SaaS in production — Astro SSR, React and Alpine.js over Moleculer microservices — built in TDD and BDD/Gherkin, with feature flags, Vitest and Playwright suites, and Docker → Google Cloud Run deployments.
Designed and shipped the access-controlled note sharing system: a per-role permission matrix, sharing scoped to a programme or session, and automatic revocation of access on events.
Built an in-house Alpine.js lazy-loading layer for ~40 components using dynamic imports and skeleton-first rendering, cutting the initial JS bundle. Adopted by the whole team.
Led the response to an npm supply-chain malware incident: forensic investigation of a hijacked Git commit, then detection tooling and a blocking pre-commit hook.

projects.name: MAAG
highlights: Designed and built an online media outlet now in production entirely on my own — front end, API and infrastructure: 67,000 lines, 187 Astro components, 20 REST controllers.
Custom CMS driving 8 editorial content types through 51 admin screens, with a block editor of 15 typed block types including composite layouts.
Editorial placement engine: the composition of the home page is itself an editable entity, each slot switching between manual selection and rule-based auto-fill.
Express.js API on Firebase / Firestore, Sharp image pipeline, 9 versioned migrations (dry-run / apply), Stripe subscriptions, GDPR banner, technical SEO, Docker → Cloud Run with GitHub Actions CI.

projects.name: Robofleet
highlights: Management and monitoring interface built with React 18 and Mantine Core.
Stripe billing with recurring subscriptions, Prisma data modelling, and a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline deploying over SSH.

projects.name: wurkspaces.dev
highlights: Bilingual (FR / EN) showcase site in Astro, Alpine.js and Tailwind, with a GDPR cookie banner built as a reusable Astro module.
